subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: Each scenario shall declare a cost class — deterministic, bounded-model, or full-session — and a run cadence — per-change, scheduled, checkpoint, or on-demand — alongside its route, and the harness section shall state the per-run bound that keeps a scheduled run inside it.
rationale: the route says how a behavior is proven and the cost class says what proving it costs; declaring both makes the suite's economics a reviewable property of the design rather than a surprise for the build
fit_criterion: on the dogfood and the fixtures, every scenario carries exactly one cost class and one cadence, and the harness section states a per-run bound; a reviewer can derive the cost of a scheduled run from the doc alone; a scenario with no cost class or no cadence is a well-formedness defect
